# Volume I: Commercial Governance, Contract Administration, and Pre-Contract Cost Planning

This volume establishes the commercial foundation for mission-critical data center delivery under turnkey EPC frameworks (FIDIC Silver Book), hybrid procurement demarcation (OFCI vs. CFCI), pre-contract cost benchmarking ($/kW and $/MW), and 5D BIM digital takeoff methodologies.
